freeze_timing: Frozen before Phase-6 and Phase-7 adjudications are visible.
scientific_question: Does the K2 origin-state operation act before or after the frozen SWITCH_LINE cipher transformation, and is that ordering stable across dwell/reset contexts?

prerequisites.phase7: must complete with replication_guard_pass=true; Phase-8 POST arms are checked against the corresponding Phase-7 medians before ordering is adjudicated

invariants.cipher_plan_rule: Generate the cipher plan once from the original plaintext lines using seed_of('P5-plan',doc,replicate); reuse that exact plan for PRE and POST ordering.

ordering.POST: ciphered = encode_with_plan(plain, frozen_plan, representation); output = apply_k2_states(ciphered, state_sequence)
ordering.PRE: rotated_plain = apply_k2_states(plain, state_sequence); output = encode_with_plan(rotated_plain, frozen_plan, representation)
ordering.important: The frozen cipher plan is always generated from the unmodified original plaintext, so PRE versus POST changes only operator order, not plan generation.

baselines.ORIGIN_ONLY: apply_k2_states(plain, state_sequence), scored as a secondary mechanistic diagnostic

primary_test.metric: robust d3 = worst ATOMIC/LITERAL distance_of_median_Q3; lower is better
primary_test.paired_difference: Delta_order = d3_PRE - d3_POST; positive means cipher→state (POST) is better
primary_test.estimator: median paired-document Delta_order within each locked stratum
primary_test.materiality_basis: Inherited prospectively from Phase-4 same-law noise control.

replication_guard.rule: Before ordering inference, each Phase-8 POST stratum median must equal the corresponding completed Phase-7 arm median to absolute tolerance 1e-12. The expected reset medians are read from the immutable Phase-7 final artifact, not selected or tuned.

adjudication_rules.POST_ORDER_REQUIRED_ALL: All four strata have lower 95% CI of Delta_order > +0.04.
adjudication_rules.PRE_ORDER_REQUIRED_ALL: All four strata have upper 95% CI of Delta_order < -0.04.
adjudication_rules.ORDER_EQUIVALENT_ALL: All four strata have entire 95% CI inside [-0.04,+0.04].
adjudication_rules.POST_ORDER_ROBUST_MAJORITY: At least 3/4 strata have lower 95% CI > +0.04 and no stratum has upper 95% CI < -0.04.
adjudication_rules.PRE_ORDER_ROBUST_MAJORITY: At least 3/4 strata have upper 95% CI < -0.04 and no stratum has lower 95% CI > +0.04.
adjudication_rules.ORDER_DIRECTIONALLY_CONSISTENT: All four median Delta_order values have the same nonzero sign but no prior rule applies.

phase9_link.rule: Phase-8 Q-based ordering is mechanistic selection only. The Phase-9 confirmatory verdict is determined exclusively by the already-sealed independent consequence panel.

execution_guard.rule: Protocol/code/preregistration are committed without a workflow. Workflow launch occurs only after Phase-7 replication guard passes.
